_comment: Control 4 (second half). Alias: Microsoft.Network/applicationGateways/firewallPolicy.id. A gateway with no policy at ANY scope is non-compliant. Per-listener policies are not visible to this rule - that is a documented limitation to record in the findings report.
displayName: Application Gateway must have an associated WAF policy
description: A WAF_v2 gateway without a firewallPolicy reference is running without an attached WAF policy.
